item.title: DISTRICT 2 GIRLS BASKETBALL: Hazleton Area repeats as Class 6A champs
item.description: WILKES-BARRE TWP. — These Hazleton Area singers can play a little basketball. Their friends are pretty good at the game, too. One night after wowing a packed house at their home gym with their rendition of the national anthem, Kaitlyn Bindas, Sophia Benyo and Addy Fritz returned to their regular gigs on Friday night: helping the Lady Cougars maintain its stranglehold on the District 2 Class 6A girls’ championship. item.title: NE REGIONAL WRESTLING: Spindler, Benyos advance to 3A semis
item.description: BETHLEHEM — Last season, Brody Spindler battled illness and fell short of qualifying for states. Now, the Pittston Area senior wrestler is off to a perfect start at the Class 3A Northeast Regional. Ranked 11th in the state at 215 pounds according to PA Power Wrestling, Spindler pinned Johnathan Adjin-Attey in the Round of 16 and gutted out a 4-1 victory in tiebreaker two over Williamsport’s Jackson Raker (22nd in state) in the quarterfinals Friday at Liberty High School.
